smk37.what: Polivoks on the SMK-37 Elite — 37 velocity keys, 16 RGB pads, 8 encoders, 4 faders, two wheels. Same Polivoks engine as the FM-1 build; the extra controls map onto the same synth. Branded Polivokz to avoid the Formanta trademark.
